description: DS-env (DeepSeek backend, A3 target) — per-worker infra quirks to frontload

quirks.rule: SSH is sandboxed inside claude --print. Use sandbox-disable for any remote command.
quirks.workaround: add dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true to all Bash() calls that touch SSH

quirks.rule: LOCAL_TASK dir is readonly within sandbox. Write to /tmp/<op>_lane<N>/ instead.
quirks.workaround: before deploy: mkdir -p /tmp/<op>_lane<N>/; cp kernel files there; then deploy from /tmp

quirks.rule: CANN 9.0 libs at /usr/local/Ascend/cann. LD_LIBRARY_PATH must explicitly include devlib and driver paths.
KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY) is arch35-only on V220/Ascend910_9382. Causes RegisterAscendBinary 107000.
quirks.workaround: Do NOT emit KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT on A3/V220. Use bare __global__ __aicore__ entry.

preamble_text: This worker is running on DS-env (DeepSeek V4 backend, A3/V220 target). Three known infra quirks: (1) SSH requires sandbox-disable, (2) LOCAL_TASK is readonly — use /tmp, (3) CANN lib64 + devlib require explicit LD_LIBRARY_PATH, (4) KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT is arch35-only — omit on V220. The validate_ds_env.sh preflight has confirmed all dependencies are reachable.
